inputs.prompt: A gothic horror oil painting. A skeletal ghost in a torn black cloak stands in the doorway of an abandoned cathedral at midnight, holding a rusty ceremonial sword pointed toward the floor. Empty eye sockets glow faint green, thick fog rolls over broken stone tiles, a red moon is visible through a shattered stained-glass window. Ominous atmosphere, dramatic chiaroscuro, no blood, no injuries, no text.
